quotes: Andariel's Visage (ethereal) socketed with Ruby Jewel of Fervor (15% IAS / 30 Fire Res)

This version is the best for dealing with the Ubers: Open Wounds from Gore Rider to stop regeneration, Cannot Be Frozen, Crushing Blow from Gore Rider and Guillaume's Face, and charms for 75 Lightning Resistance against Uber Mephisto's Conviction.

The first is having a source of x% Chance of Open Wounds, which is obtained from Gore Rider to stop regeneration. Cannot Be Frozen allows you to maintain fast attack speed for applying Open Wounds and dealing massive damage through Crushing Blow, which is gained from Gore Rider and Guillaume's Face.

The charms are for boosting resistances, so that you have 75 Lightning Resistance vs Uber Mephisto's Conviction. Enigma provides mobility via Teleport. Make sure to lay Sigil: Lethargy on each boss and recast as needed. Use Consume on a Summon Goatman for the damage and life buff.
